lines.en: label yumispring9:
scene nightsky
sud-den (sədn) adjective - when a thing happens but you didn’t know the thing was going to happen and now it’s happening.
scene yumikonbiniwalk1
: Onii-chan!
: Either buy something or get out, asshole. I’ve got the right to refuse service to anyone, you know.
: Why is there always a horn section in the music for you two?
scene yumikonbiniwalk2
: Horn section?
: Not this shit again. Dude’s been hearing fucking theme music for me since the moment he first decided to never leave me alone again.
scene yumikonbiniwalk3
: I have theme music?! I want to hear! What the heck?! You can’t just hold out on me like this!
: Fine. Let me just tap into my brain and-
scene yumikonbiniwalk4
: Yup. There it is.
: Wow. That quick?
: Yeah. Now if only I could harness that same method to make myself happy.

: On the bright side, you not being able to do that makes me a more important figure in your life as the perfect little sister who exists as a ray of sunshine put here to brighten up all of your days.
: That’s nice and all. But I’m going to put Yumi’s theme back on now since I haven’t heard it in a while and it’s kind of nostalgic.
: You’d think talking to the girl you watched grow up would be a little more nostalgic, but okay.
: Still waiting on you to buy something.
: How much for your hairpin?
scene yumikonbiniwalk5
: IT’S NOT FOR SALE!
: Why not? It’s not even doing anything. Like, what are you trying to hold in place? Your hair is straight.
: It’s a fucking decoration, okay?!
: Yeah, Onii-chan. Yumi just wants to look cute and we should let her exercise her self-expression in order to achieve that goal.
scene yumikonbiniwalk6
: Like I give a fuck about looking cute! Now, you buy something too or I’m kicking you both out! You’re off the clock, aren’t you?!

: I am! And I’m also not convinced you aren’t lying to me right now because girls don’t decorate their hair with cute little pins to look more intimidating or whatever it is you’re going to pretend to want instead!
: Still waiting on a price. I need it for my Yumi collection.
scene yumikonbiniwalk7
: What else do you fucking have of mine?!
: Your first kiss.
scene yumikonbiniwalk8
: On second thought, I just quit.
: Why?! There’s nothing wrong with being kiss-cousins! Onii-chan took mine too! And my sister’s! And your best friend’s!
scene yumikonbiniwalk9
: Actually, probably your entire floor now that I think about it.
: You tryin’ to say there are still survivors on the second floor?
: Otoha is a hard nut to crack, Yumi. Also, Tsuneyo was weird and I don’t think that one counts.
scene yumikonbiniwalk10
: What about Yasu? Because omitting her implies you two have kissed already and I would very much like to know what sort of development led to that.
: Oh. Yeah, no. I haven’t kissed her either. I just don’t really think about her sexually outside of very specific, spontaneous contexts so I didn’t even think about including her there.
: You should kiss me in more spontaneous contexts. Like when I’m at dinner with my parents. That’d be a really funny reunion.
: I think we have vastly different ideas of what is and isn’t funny, Noriko.
: Have you ever even laughed before? Cause I sure as fuck ain’t seen it.
: Me neither, now that I think about it. And you’ve fucked my mouth.
scene yumikonbiniwalk11
: Ew! The fuck does that have to do with anything?!
: Nothing really. I just wanted to brag for a second to let you know whose man you will be thieving if you try to make a move after I leave.
: Leave? Where are you going? I need a bodyguard if I’m going to be around Yumi.
scene yumikonbiniwalk12
: I’m going to the movies with Kirin. But hey, Tsuneyo is only a couple blocks away if you find yourself in trouble. Maybe she can help?
: You’re going to leave Yumi alone here?
: I work alone all the time, asshole. I’m like, actually responsible now and shit.
scene yumikonbiniwalk13
: Besides, we’re closing for some renovation bullshit in like an hour anyway. I just gotta mop or whatever.
: Bring her back to me in one piece. Okay, Onii-chan? She’s going to be one of my bridesmaids one day.
: So will Kirin I imagine, but you’ve never told me to bring her back in one piece.
: Well, duh. Kirin’s the kind of girl you’re supposed to break.
scene yumikonbiniwalk14
: That said- I’m probably gonna be late, so I’ve gotta go! Be good, you two! And in the event that you aren’t, record what happens and show me later! Bye-bye! Love you both!
: Love you-
: Do not speak such words around me even if they are directed at someone else.
: You’re going to make a terrible bridesmaid.
: You don’t say.
: So, how are things?
: Yumi?
: What? You came all the way to a fucking convenience store in the Old District to not buy anything and you’re confused about why I’m not acting all buddy-buddy with you?
: Hey, beats coming over here for the sole purpose of contemplating throwing myself off a bridge.
scene yumikonbiniwalk15
: Now, I don’t know if I’d go that far. I say you go give it a shot so we can know for sure.
: You’d be upset and you know it.
: Ehh. I’d get over it in like a week.
scene yumikonbiniwalk16
: Might help prepare me for my mom’s death too. So for all we know, you could be doin’ me a favor by dying. You’d sure as fuck be doing a favor to a bunch of other people.
: So, about that time you kissed me on the cheek in a love hotel-
scene yumikonbiniwalk17
: No! Not about that time! You drop that shit right now and just...help me fucking mop or something!
: If I help you mop, will you let me walk you home afterward?
scene yumikonbiniwalk18
: Sure, yeah. Whatever. I guess that’s...fine.
: Yeah, I had a feeling you wouldn’t-
: Wait what? Did you...did you actually just agree to that?
: Depends. Are you going to immediately make me regret it?
scene yumikonbiniwalk19
: Well, don’t just fucking stand there or I definitely will regret it! You had every opportunity to not make this shit weird and you’re already fucking that up!
: Oh, sorry. Yeah. That just...caught me off guard.
scene yumikonbiniwalk20
: Yeah, well...you don’t stalk me even half as much as you used to anymore, so just...see it as a one-time thank you for, like...actually leaving me alone and shit...
: The mop’s in the back room, by the way.
: Oh. You’re, like...you actually want me to mop.
: And make sure you don’t miss anything since the contractors will be here in a couple hours.
: Thanks, Sensei. I knew I could count on you.
: You’re lucky I have a thing for girls who are mean to me.
: And you’re lucky I’m a fucking moron. Now go, like...do shit before I regret this even more. And stop looking at me, already. It’s embarrassing.
: Because you’re blushing?
scene yumikonbiniwalk21
: Y...Yeah...
Oh my god.
scene black
Not wanting to ruin the moment for what may very well be the first time in my life, I make my way into the back room and manage to find the mop closet.
But by the time I get back, Yumi is nowhere to be found and the sign on the door has been switched to “Closed.”
Now, am I surprised that she would just trick me into closing the store like this so she could bail without me? Not at all.
But I’m going to go out on a limb here and say it was all worth it because-
: Did you put the right shit in there? You’ve gotta use the soap first and then go over it again with sanitizing shit after.
: Oh. You’re still here?

: Uhh...yeah? You think I’d just fucking leave this place to somebody like you? That ain’t how this shit works, dude. You’ve gotta, like...earn trust and whatnot before you can be alone here. And that’s-
: See, yeah. You already fucked up. You need to dump that out and fill it with the soapy shit instead. Want me to show you?
: Uhh...o...okay. Sure.
Uhh...
Yumi teaches me how to mop?
scene yumikonbiniwalk22
And then we’re...back outside. And I’m walking her home.
This is a totally and completely normal night that I definitely predicted when I decided to head over to the convenience store.
: The fuck do you keep looking at me like that for?
: Yumi...do you have cancer too?
scene yumikonbiniwalk23
: What?! I fucking hope not! Why?! Does it...can you tell? Does it look like I have it? Because I know that shit can be genetic or whatever, but-
: It’s not like that. You’re just being unusually warm to me now that Noriko’s gone. I’m not...really used to that from you, I guess.
scene yumikonbiniwalk24
: Oh. Well...yeah.
: Yeah, I guess that would probably seem pretty weird if you weren’t expecting it. But, like...like, it’s not like I’m always a bitch to you, right?
: Like...when all that shit went down with my mom, you were there for me. And, so...like...
: I don’t know. I just figured we were kinda...different now. A lot’s happened and...and yeah. Just...a lot’s happened.
: You’re okay then? Not going to suddenly die on me?
scene yumikonbiniwalk25
: Not if I have any control over it...hahah...hah...
scene yumikonbiniwalk26
: Hah...
Well, would you look at this?
It appears that all it took to chip away at the seemingly unbreakable shell that covered Yumi was being in the right place at the wrong time.
And no, it’s not like I’m confident that I’ve finally got her hooked now that she’s nibbling the bait, but...
I’ve been out at sea for a long time. And I’ve gotten so bored at failing to catch any fish in the depths of these peaceful waters that just the company of one is enough to bring me joy for now.
How unfortunate that such joy is once again laced with a tinge of tragedy, but I suppose that’s how these things always are.
It’s hard to look up while you’re falling. So chances are Yumi became so accustomed to her endless descent that she’d all but given up on the prospects of ascension and light as a whole.
So at the bottom of the well she’d fallen to...when she was finally able to take a look at the place she’d landed, she must have mistaken me for the sun as I peered over the ledge to call out to her.
I, too, made that same mistake once. And there’s not a day that’s gone by that I haven’t paid for it.
But, at the same time...there’s not a day that goes by where I don’t want it back.
Youth is such a funny thing. How impressionable. How pure.
When you get to my age, everyone’s just sludge. Walking masses of scar tissue from all the times we’ve been burned, overflowing with guilt and decay that we try to wish away in the mirror but can’t.
When she looks, she sees a hairpin.
No guilt. No decay. No scars or burns or sludge at all.
And I love that.
I love that she can decorate herself. That she still sees color in all of this.
It makes me want to saturate her.
: We’ve really come a long way, haven’t we?
scene yumikonbiniwalk27
: Huh?
: Or I guess you’ve come a long way.
: It feels like just the other day we were beginning the Yumi Revitalization Project. Where you didn’t even understand what “sex” meant on job applications and I had to teach you myself.
scene yumikonbiniwalk28
: Why do you even remember that? That was so long ago.
: You remember it too, obviously.
: Yeah, because I was embarrassed. It’s much easier remembering shit like that when you’re the one it happens to.
: It’s all in the past now. Like I said, you’ve come a long way.
: You’ve got a job now. You’ve got an apartment — albeit one that sort of fell into your lap. But still, you’ve done some stuff with the place. You even bought curtains. I’ve never bought curtains.
scene yumikonbiniwalk29
: You’ve got Noriko now. Even if you don’t want her. And you’ve got your mom too. Even if you don’t want to admit that.
: And you.
: Me?
: Yeah. Like...I can be with you without fearing for my life anymore.
: I...trust you. As weird as that is to say after you literally sexually assaulted me.
scene yumikonbiniwalk30
: That was-
: Complicated. I know.
scene yumikonbiniwalk31
: But what isn’t these days?
: Time loops...apocalypses...mind-bending paranormal god things that make me fear for my life before puking me right back out into this cesspool of a city...
: Comin’ around to trusting you after how shit started off is, like...the least crazy thing that’s happened to me over the last few years.
scene yumikonbiniwalk32
: Besides, you throwin’ yourself at me taught me I just always need to be prepared to kick you in the balls if you try it again.
: Which you will. Because your brain is apparently just as fucked up as this whole damn world.

: Guess life ain’t all that different from manga at the end of the day. There’s plenty of reality-defying shit out there. You’ve just gotta wait for it to come to you instead of going out to look for it.
: That has seemed to work lately. Little by little, our team is expanding. And soon enough, we’ll all be in this together.
: Hope you’re wrong. I kinda like how it is now. The thought of more people gettin’ involved just makes me want to go back to normal.

: But if you go back to normal, we won’t have such a weird and paranormal thing in common anymore. Plus, if you get reset, I’ll have to start all over with you and redo all of the progress we’ve made.
: Guess it’d be kind of annoying from my POV too. You’re way more bearable now that I know you’re a helpless loser instead of a hopeless loser.
: Hey, you’re kind of a loser too, you know. We’re both pretty terrible people at the end of the day.
: Damn right. Think we’re both pretty content with not getting any better too based on our track records.
: I’m worse, though.
: Way worse. I ain’t a sketchy rapist who’s probably thinking about how to get invited into some teenager’s apartment right now.
scene yumikonbiniwalk33
: I think I left something in your pants.
: You mean my room?
: Yes. What did I say?
: Thanks for walking me home. Now, get the fuck out of here before I call the cops and tell ‘em some stalker’s harassing me again.
: You’re smiling a lot today.
: And you’re stalling.
: I don’t want to go home.
: Because you’ve got an incestuous future-serial killer living there?
: Because I know you’ll stop smiling.
: You would think my happiness is entirely dependent on your presence. It’s not, dumbass.
: You’re okay then? With everything going on with your mom and Chika and having to hold down a job and-
: And the fact that I’ll probably never grow old and that there’s a weird sarcastic voice inside of my head dead-set on making my life a living hell? Yeah. I’m okay.
: Let me know if you start hearing theme music. That’s how I’ll know it’s gotten really bad.
: We’ll see. I’m saving your presence for all of the shit I can’t handle on my own. There ain’t much that fits that bill, though.
: Is it wrong for me to say I hope someone else you love gets sick so I can spend the night with you again?
: Very fucking wrong. Yes.
: Got it. I’ll probably just leave then.
: And I’ll probably go upstairs and pass the fuck out. Night.
: Goodnight, Yumi. Call me if you need anything.
: No thanks.
scene black
: This was more than enough you for the rest of the year, I think...
I turn to leave, having successfully escorted Yumi back to her apartment without anything weird happening.
Well...apart from the fact that our relationship is just comparably weird now given how it’s been in the past.
That’s the type of “weird” I can’t get enough of, though. And if you were to ask me what I think about what it means for the future, I’d say-
: Actually...
: Huh?
: Do you want to come inside?...
scene yumikonbiniwalk34
: J...Just for like...tea or whatever. I...I just realized you never bought anything from the konbini and...it’s kind of a long walk, so...I’d feel, like...bad and shit if you just left now...
: Cute romance song...
scene yumikonbiniwalk35
: C-Cut it out with the fucking background soundtrack shit! This ain’t some kind of fucking rom-com!
scene yumikonbiniwalk36
: Sorry. I couldn’t help it. It felt like one for a second.
I’ll just use a softer one instead. This way she won’t know.
scene yumikonbiniwalk37
: You don’t need to apologize or whatever, just...either come or don’t come. I don’t really care either way. Just...wanted to give you the option.
: Are you sure? It’s late. Don’t you need to wake up early for school tomorrow?
: Yeah. So? Not like that’s ever really been at the top of the priority list for me.
: No. And I didn’t think I was either, but-
scene yumikonbiniwalk38
: Ugh...forget it, actually. I don’t know what I was thinking inviting some fucking predator into my-
: Sure, Yumi. I’ll come up for a drink.
scene yumikonbiniwalk39
: Y...Yeah?...You will?
: Yeah. I will.
: Then I...uhh...
: I might not...have any tea, actually...
: It might just...be water.
: Sorry, I...wasn’t really thinking when I-
: Anything is fine. It doesn’t matter.
: Okay. There still...like I might have it. I just don’t remember off the top of my head.
: Are you the one stalling now? Have we switched places?
: You’re really coming in?
: Are you having second thoughts?
: No...But I was...barely having first thoughts either, so...
scene black
: Lead the way...
